verdict.rationale: Khoj's source is public on GitHub (github.com/khoj-ai/khoj). A community member reports reading the code, and another comment says the project is GPL-3, which is an open-source license. Self-hosting via pip or Docker is also documented. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license (the GPL-3 identification comes only from a community comment) and first-party docs on reading or contributing to the source.
